test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Most times, he is sitting alone, immersed in his own _______.
solution:
The correct answer is: **monologue.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"monologue"** means a long speech by one person during a conversation or performance. (स्वगत भाषण)

 
 
• **Example: **The actor's monologue captivated the audience for over ten minutes.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that he sits by himself most of the time, lost in his own thoughts.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is **'monologue'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Synagogue** (यहूदी प्रार्थना भवन): A Jewish house of worship.

 
 
• **Example:** The community gathered at the synagogue for the Sabbath services.
 
 
 
• **Mystagogue** (रहस्यवादी): A person who initiates others into mystic beliefs.
 
 
• **Example: **The mystagogue taught his followers the secrets of the ancient rites.
 
 
 
• **Prologue** (प्रस्तावना): An introductory section of a literary or musical work.
 
 
• **Example:** The prologue of the novel set the stage for the unfolding drama.
